title: Runway and pricing stress test for an agency-to-SaaS move
scenario:
TOPIC: Stress-test the finances of moving an automation agency to SaaS
A founder has ₹12 lakh cash, agency revenue of ₹3 lakh per month, and ₹2.4 lakh monthly cash expenses. She wants to pause client sales for three months, spend ₹6 lakh building SaaS, charge ₹15,000 per month, and reach 40 customers by month six. Customer invoices would be collected net 30 while contractor bills are due immediately. Critique the financial plan, rank the assumptions that could kill it, expose missing numbers and cash-timing risk, propose the cheapest validation test with cost and duration, and end with a fund / fund-with-conditions / do-not-fund verdict.

bad_signs.name: budget-only advice
bad_signs.pattern: create a budget|keep an eye on costs

improvement_suggestions: Show how money arriving later than bills changes the survival window.
Attack the most fragile assumption before discussing secondary concerns.
Recommend a cheap real-world commitment before approving the build.
